ai_provenance.evidence_basis: what came back for this input, and which resource gave it. Level 1 - inputs and outputs only; the highest level anything here reaches, and not a measurement of the resource beyond this answer

quality.delivery_coverage_basis: 4 declared section(s) checked against the delivered content
quality.stub_screen_basis: the length and stub screen ran on this text, whether or not the coverage gate could: no stub marker matched and the text is not under the minimum length

verdicts.reason: the text screened contains halal vocabulary ('halal') and no prohibited (haram) term matched — the screen cannot tell whether that word is the subject's own claim or wording this platform composed around it; either way it is not a certification and not an assessment; a halal verdict comes from a certifying body (engine ran and produced no finding here, so it backs no verdict)

no engine covers this area — keyword screen + employment-statute vocabulary matched nothing (jurisdiction UK / London); not legal advice (UK engine ran and produced no finding here, so it backs no verdict · audit ab87edac222bb7d7… over the subject)
keyword screen found no regulated-activity trigger — the absence of a trigger word is not a regulatory clearance; nothing here assessed this subject
keyword screen found no hazard term — the absence of a hazard word is not an EHS clearance; nothing here assessed this subject
human: not_assessed; environment: not_assessed; quality: not_assessed; value: not_assessed (engine ran and produced no finding here, so it backs no verdict)

compliance.basis: keyword and vocabulary screens plus the ethical dimensions. A screen can refuse and can escalate; it cannot clear — so only a row with coverage 'engine' can carry a pass, and `coverage_gaps` names every area nothing here assessed. Matched only by a word list, which establishes nothing either way: sharia_halal — NOTHING here assessed this subject, so the overall is 'review' and no part of it may be reported as compliant

quality.qms_basis: not assessable — floor-served: the deterministic floor emits the requested headings, so coverage cannot fail by construction and the stub regex never matches its vocabulary; no instrument here can say whether this content is good

qms_defects.closed_basis: 'closed' counts defects re-verified and passed. A defect closed because its source was retired, or reported not reproducible, was not re-verified: each is counted apart and moves nothing in the rate
qms_defects.dispositions_basis: 0 defect(s) closed because the surface that opened them was retired and 0 reported not reproducible, each with the reason, name and time its person gave; neither is a re-verification, so neither is counted as closed above, as a gate pass or in the rate. Open now under a label no live surface opens a defect under: 0
qms_defects.attested_basis: No caller-attested re-verification has been counted: the counter starts at the first one after it was added, and any run before that is in the rate and not in this count. 0 defect(s) closed now were last re-verified on typed figures. By ruling (OWNER 2026-10-11) attested re-verifications STAY in the rate: these counts stand beside it and change it by nothing.
qms_defects.rate_basis: gate failures / gates run across ALL deliveries on this platform (every entity and tenant share one QMS store) — not one entity's record. What-if gates run on typed metrics, and re-verifications of the defects they open, are counted separately and excluded. A re-verification of a DELIVERY defect does count, including one attested by its caller (W316: a correction that does not hold must raise the rate).

specifically designed.basis: not assessable — floor-served: the deterministic floor emits the requested headings, so coverage cannot fail by construction and the stub regex never matches its vocabulary; no instrument here can say whether this content is good

verified.basis: not assessable — floor-served: the deterministic floor emits the requested headings, so coverage cannot fail by construction and the stub regex never matches its vocabulary; no instrument here can say whether this content is good

compliant.basis: §11 screen verdicts: {'sharia_halal': 'review', 'uk_legal': 'review', 'regulatory': 'not_assessed', 'ehs': 'not_assessed', 'ethical': 'not_assessed'} — not established: ehs, ethical, regulatory, sharia_halal, uk_legal could not assess this subject (a keyword screen can refuse, not clear)

bar_measured.not_measured_basis: 16 = 14 with no source + 2 screen-only: a criterion only a screen read is not measured either. The summary prints the two as separate buckets so that its figures add up to the bar's 16
bar_measured.gate_measurements_summary: none - the gate did not run on this output (see the criteria's basis)
bar_measured.gate_measurements_basis: structure only: whether every declared section heading is present, and whether a stub marker (or too little text) was found. The content was not read, so a pass here is not a finding that the delivery is specifically designed or verified

immune.health_basis: health and threat are computed from 0 failure(s) in the window; 0 compliance review flag(s) are reported beside them and are NOT counted — a flag asks a human to look, it is not a finding of harm
immune.observed_basis: 2 call(s) were observed in the last 5 minutes

layer_basis.Genome: agentic_core/organism/genome.py — encode/crossover/mutate, mounted under /api/v1/organism/genome; a quality record does not exercise it
layer_basis.Nervous: agentic_core/organism/nervous.py — the fire_signal below routes into the NervousSystem; it contributes no value to this record
layer_basis.Immune: agentic_core/organism/immune.py — immune.status() is read into this record
layer_basis.Cardiovascular: agentic_core/app_mvp.py serves resource_flow = 100 - cpu_percent as 'cardiovascular'. That is host CPU headroom, honestly measured, under an anatomical name — there is no circulatory subsystem
layer_basis.Respiratory: agentic_core/api/agent_hub.py — the Agent Hub (the vision's 17.2 map): a bus that RECORDS messages between agents; nothing is subscribed to execute what it records, and a quality record does not exercise it. NOT THE LAYER: agentic_core/molecular/triad_integration.py CANNOT BE IMPORTED: it imports six siblings from agentic_core/molecular/ and only atp_simulator still exists (p53_oscillator, ubiquitin_system, hsp_network, redox_sensor and chaperone_cascade were archived), so it raises ModuleNotFoundError and the TriadIntegrator can never be instantiated. Nothing imports it either, but that is the weaker of the two facts - this basis used to say it held a REAL TriadIntegrator, which is what code_exists_unreached is meant to mean
layer_basis.Musculoskeletal: agentic_core/api/resource_fabric.py — composable facilities that run real engines, EXCEPT the composed Digital Twin stage, which is a model-written scenario narrative and runs no simulator; a quality record does not exercise them
layer_basis.Endocrine: agentic_core/organism/biobus.py — the signal bus and shared context (the vision's 17.2 map); this record's own fire_signal travels on it and it contributes no value to the record. NOT THE LAYER, though it carries a similar name: agentic_core/biomimicry/geospheric/regulator.py holds a HomeostaticRegulator that does a PROPORTIONAL THRESHOLD COMPARISON and names a corrective action as a string - no integral accumulates, no derivative is read, nothing actuates - and NOTHING IMPORTS IT; a second copy of the same class sits in geospheric/homeostatic_regulator.py. W434's note vouched for this layer and W446 measured that vouching as the overclaim

biomimetic.layers_note: 1 of 7 declared layers contributed a value to this record: Immune. Engaged on this path without contributing a value: Nervous, Endocrine. Implemented and reachable, but not on this path: Genome, Respiratory, Musculoskeletal. A measurement published under this anatomical name, not an organ: Cardiovascular. `layer_basis` names the module behind each claim.
